rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 8-1 coalition together with a narrow, administrable reading that gives independent work to “during and in relation to” and avoids making §1028A an automatic add-on in routine billing fraud. Alito is likely to write alone to defend the government’s but-for/“mechanism of payment” theory, while Gorsuch (lenity) and Thomas (text/ordinary meaning) are the most likely majority members to add separate concurrences.
